name: Elvira
description: a chibi gothic hostess with a huge jet-black beehive of hair and long straight sides with blunt bangs, pale skin, smoky purple eyeshadow, red lips, a black plunging long gown with flared sleeves and a high leg slit, black sheer stockings, silver dagger earrings and a striped silver choker
rules: big head, small body: the head and hair are about half her height
jet-black beehive hair, the same shape in every pose
purple eyeshadow and red lips; her eyes change with each pose's mood (spirals only when dizzy)
black long gown with a high leg slit, a thin black belt with a small silver buckle
silver dagger earrings and a striped silver choker
black shoes; arms short enough to wave, type and run
